decisions.reason: Displaying help text in both the control label and field does not change the established Danish language or placeholder strings.
The help-text display locations do not change the field implementation mechanism or robustness requirements.
The source changes where help text is displayed, not when or how placeholder text clears upon field activation.
Displaying help text in two locations does not resolve or modify the separate requirement for grey editable-field cues.
The source does not change the requirement to preserve Title-field formatting during interaction.
The calendar-dropdown date-entry mechanism remains valid and unchanged.
The help-text location decision does not alter the checklist and dropdown control configuration.
The shared label terminology is incidental; image and table caption styling is unaffected.
The source decision about field help-text locations has no effect on the required theme color palette.
The Enter-key bullet-creation behavior is unrelated to field help-text placement.
The source does not modify bullet appearance, alignment, scaling, or color.
The numbered-list alignment requirement is semantically unaffected by field help-text placement.
